title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 12: the priests and Levites who returned, and the joyful dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

questions.text: The priests and Levites went up with Zerubbabel. Whose son was Zerubbabel?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:1 speaks of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua.

questions.text: Who became the father of Jaddua?
questions.explanation: The line runs from Jeshua through Joiakim, Eliashib and Joiada to Jonathan, who became the father of Jaddua.

questions.text: In whose reign were the priests recorded, according to verse 22?
questions.explanation: The heads of fathers' households were recorded, and also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.

questions.text: According to whose commandment did the chiefs of the Levites praise and give thanks?
questions.explanation: They praised and gave thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, watch next to watch.

questions.text: With which instruments were the Levites to keep the dedication of the wall?
questions.explanation: They were brought to keep the dedication with gladness, giving thanks and singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments and harps.

answers.text: Drums, flutes and bells of silver

questions.text: What does verse 29 say the singers had done?
questions.explanation: The singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.

answers.text: Built a tower by the water gate

questions.text: Besides themselves and the people, what did the priests and Levites purify?
questions.explanation: The priests and Levites purified themselves, the people, the gates and the wall.

questions.text: How many great companies of thanksgiving were appointed to go on the wall?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah brought the princes of Judah up on the wall and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession.

questions.text: Who went before the musicians with the instruments of David?
questions.explanation: Verse 36 says the brothers went with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe was before them.

questions.text: How far was the joy of Jerusalem heard on the day of the dedication?
questions.explanation: They offered great sacrifices and rejoiced, women and children too, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.

answers.text: As far as the king's palace in Susa
